description: This file implements functions for setting up and managing a Minijail sandbox environment, including reading policies, creating pipes, and initializing the jail with seccomp filters.

classes.name: ScopedMinijail
classes.description: RAII wrapper for minijail object, managing its lifetime.

methods.name: WritePolicyToPipe
methods.description: Concatenates policy contents and writes them to a pipe, returning the read end file descriptor.

methods.name: SetUpMinijail
methods.description: Sets up a minijail environment with a base and additional policy files.

methods.name: SetUpMinijailList
methods.description: Reads policy files, writes combined policy to a pipe, and initializes the minijail environment.
